products.description: A home loan packed with positives for future generations.
products.name: Offset Home Loan Fixed

bundles.additionalInfo: Offset loans include an annual fee waiver for the Platinum Rewards Credit Card and everyday banking.
bundles.name: Offset Loan

eligibility.additionalInfo: Individuals (natural persons) must have the legal capacity to enter into the loan contract, provide acceptable identification documentation and be 18 years or older.
Applications for loans are subject to the Bank's lending criteria.
Australian citizen or permanent resident of Australia

features.additionalInfo: You can self-serve your day-to-day banking needs via Bank Australia's App or Internet Banking.

A Mortgage Offset account reduces the amount of interest you pay on your home loan. The amount within this account is offset against your home loan, meaning you only pay interest on the difference. Up to a limit of $20,000.
Make your loan repayments weekly, fortnightly or monthly

Welcoming a new family member to the family can place a pretty big strain on finances so we offer you the option of pausing your home loan repayments to give you some breathing space. This allows you to take a break from payments for three months, or halve them for six. Conditions apply

Our Eco-Pause lets customers take a break from their mortgage repayments and redirect their money to eco upgrades such as solar panels, batteries and water tanks. With an eco-pause you can pause your repayments for three months or halve them for six. Conditions apply.
Split loan between variable and fixed is available
Additional repayments up to $30,000 during the fixed rate period

fees.additionalInfo: Annual fee payable on all Offset Home Loans and Clean Energy Home Loans. The fee is debited to the loan annually on the anniversary date of funding and is non refundable. Only one annual fee applies per customer where multiple loans exist.
fees.name: Offset Home Loan Annual Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable when you choose to lock in the fixed rate at application.  0.10% of the total fixed loan amount for approved home loan applications (minimum fee $50). This applies to 1, 2, 3 and 5 year Fixed Rate home loans only and is non-refundable.
fees.name: Rate Lock Fee

fees.additionalInfo: An annual fee charged on your credit card.

discounts.additionalInfo: We won't charge the fee if this criteria is met.
discounts.description: This fee is waived for holders of an Offset or Clean Energy Home Loan. Each Offset or Clean Energy Loan is entitled to a wavier for the future Annual Fee for one eligible card account in the name of the loan holder.

eligibility.additionalInfo: This fee is waived for holders of an Offset or Clean Energy Home Loan. Each Offset or Clean Energy Loan is entitled to a wavier for the future Annual Fee for one eligible card account in the name of the loan holder.

fees.name: Portability Fee- New Mortgage

fees.additionalInfo: You may be required to pay a break fee if you pay your fixed loan off in full, make an early repayment or make certain other changes to your loan during any fixed period. fees.name: Break Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable when you discharge the mortgage. Statutory government registration fees will still apply.
